windows.fill_assumption: ASSUMPTION_VOLUME_AT_TOUCH: a quote at the touch is assumed filled for one unit when sharesTraded strictly increased while it was live. AN ASSUMPTION, NOT EVIDENCE.

settlement.clock: LITERAL. The market serves startTime and endDate exactly 15 minutes apart, so seconds-to-expiry is a fact and the sports event-progress translation must NOT be applied
settlement.rule: settles Up iff the BRTI value at T_end is greater than or equal to the value at T_start; each value is the simple average of the 60 BRTI prices in the last minute before that time, rounded to 2 dp

provenance.book: /v1/markets/{slug}/bbo and /book -- PUBLIC BOOK IS ~30s CACHED (9 distinct ladder states across 88 polls); a fresher book requires the authenticated WS
provenance.prints: sharesTraded delta only -- /trades is 404 on the public gateway, so trade COUNT is not observable and bursts are a LOWER BOUND, never a count
provenance.fees: taker 0.0695*C*p*(1-p); maker rebate 0.0125*C*p*(1-p) credited at the point of trade and NOT counted toward edge (https://docs.polymarket.us/fees)
provenance.incentive: liquidity program crypto_up_down_20260922, pool $30 per daily_event shared across the program's markets; counted at $0 until eligibility and allocation are established

fee_schedule.maker_rebate_timing: applied at the point of trade
fee_schedule.rounding: banker's rounding to the cent, as published
fee_schedule.taker_rebate_reason: tiers start at $250,000 of prior-calendar-month taker notional; this account is below the first tier, so it is counted at zero
fee_schedule.verified_against: all 99 published price rows reproduce exactly; see tests/test_pmus_fees.py
